subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world geometry word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds and measures a shape scenario using virtual tiles tied to angles or coordinates
exercise.pictorial: Student draws and labels a diagram to represent a one-step geometry word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a one-step triangle, quadrilateral, or coordinate word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot translate word problem language into the correct diagram/model

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
